about: I'm Gokul. I'm a robotics engineer and the founder of MEI, where I'm building expressive robots. Ever since I was a kid, I've always been intrigued by how robots see, learn, and figure out what to do.

I've worked on computer vision (neuromorphic vision), reinforcement learning (autonomous drone racing), and generative AI. I have also tinkered with LLMs and fine-tuning. Lately, I've gotten my hands on an SO-101 robot arm setup and I've been experimenting with VLAs, WAMs and LLMs for manipulation tasks.

Before starting MEI, I completed my master's in Robotics, Systems and Control from ETH Zurich, where I had the opportunity to work with Prof. Davide Scaramuzza at the Robotics and Perception Group, UZH. Before that, I did my bachelor's in Mechanical Engineering at Heriot-Watt University, where I was awarded the Watt Club Medal and the James Anderson Memorial Prize.
